Sponsor a family.subject: Could {Company} help one family this holiday?
Sponsor a family.body:
Hi {Hi},

I'm Harshit, founder of CouponDonation. Families post what they need on our site: food, groceries, travel or health benefits. Each gift reaches them as a store gift card, never cash, and the giver is told when it's received and used.

Would {Company} cover one family's need this holiday? You choose the family and the amount.

We're a company, not a charity, so it isn't tax-deductible. We take no fee from the gift. 100% goes to the family.

Open to it? Reply and I'll send you two or three fundraisers to choose from.

Harshit Agrawal
Founder, CouponDonation

CouponDonation Inc., 300 Creek View Road, Suite 209, Newark, DE 19711
Reply "no thanks" and I won't write again.
